name: win-referral-request
description: Prepares a Referral Request to a client who has just seen value from your work, naming who to ask and after which moment, the specific introduction you want (a type of person and a problem), talking points for your own words, an easy way to say no, and the thank-you and loop back. Use for "run win-referral-request", "ask for a referral", "how do I ask a client for referrals", "referral ask", "asking for referrals feels needy", "get introductions from happy clients", part of the Claude Guide for Finding Clients Pack by 90n.
